reading_evidence.caveats: An independent encyclopedia work rather than a mirror of the 2007 article; its bibliography cites that article, so this is not represented as an independent research proof. Definitions select the loss convention. The logarithmic example switches to a reward convention; its negative matches the local log loss. Brier formula already has the local loss orientation. Boundary cases and measurability are supplied in the local carriers, not claimed from this treatment.
